description: Updates `displayName` (1–200 characters), `description` (up to 2,000 characters; pass `null` to clear), and/or `slug` (a rename). A slug change fails with a conflict when another active collection in the website already uses it, and when the website has a published version the rename is validated against the published site’s content queries and rejected when it would break them.

slug.description: New slug for the collection — a rename. Omit to keep the current slug. Must be unique among the website’s active collections; when the website has a published version the rename is validated against the published site’s content queries.

name: cms_collections_update
title: Update a collection
